name: test-triage.nux-nofiles.sonnet.1
result:
I ran the suite and wrote `answer.json`. Of the 400 tests, 3 fail, 2 are skipped and 1 is marked todo. I didn't change any other file.

The three failures:

| File | Test | Message |
|---|---|---|
| `test/mod07.test.js` | parses dates in March | March 31 should stay in March |
| `test/mod22.test.js` | rounds half up | 2.5 should round to 3 |
| `test/mod35.test.js` | keeps order of equal keys | equal keys must keep their order |

The skipped tests are "slow path of mod04" and "slow path of mod30". The todo test is "streams large files".

The output contains many "not ok yet, retrying once" lines. Only the three tests above are reported as failed in the final results, so I treated the rest as retries that passed.
